layman_headline: Market fear is keeping us on the sidelines — no strong buy setups yet.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood right now, with Bitcoin dropping below $63,000 and most altcoins down 5-12% over the past week. Negative news about hardware wallet vulnerabilities (Coldcard) and large BTC moves tied to Trump Media are spooking traders. While a few coins like BONK and WLD are getting cheap enough to be interesting, the overall trend is still pointing down and Bitcoin dominance is high, which means altcoins tend to suffer even more. We're watching and waiting for a clearer reversal signal before putting money to work.
layman_action: Stay patient and keep cash ready. The market is dropping but hasn't shown signs of bottoming yet. Wait for fear to either spike into extreme territory (below 20) for a contrarian buy, or for prices to stabilize and start turning up before entering.
expert_reasoning: The market environment is hostile for new alt positions: Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend, BTC dominance at 56.2% compressing alts, and BTC itself down 4.4% on the week with negative Coinbase premium on a 77-day streak. Among candidates, BONK has the strongest RSI signal at 25 (oversold), which historically has a 71% win rate per our signal credibility data, but its chart bias is -0.7 with bearish structure and no visible support levels — making stop-loss placement dangerous. WLD presents a cleaner setup with defined support at $0.30, neutral RSI, and 2.4x risk/reward, but the broader macro headwinds (Coldcard vulnerabilities rattling sentiment, South Korean stablecoin outflows of $367M, ZeroStack survival risk) argue against initiating positions now. I'm issuing HOLD until we see either a Fear & Greed capitulation below 20 or a confirmed bounce off key support levels.
